notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W1-8-Q01 'Tilting truck (symbol) (L & R)' warning sign (2020), both hands drawn and fully dimensioned (no size table: one size, 3000 x 1700, R200); (L) is the drawn hand, (R) the mirror image (the sheet's (R) drawing is the mirror, with the speed numeral again under the arrow). Border read from the sheet's vectors: black band from 20 to 60 in from the edge, i.e. yellow edge 20 + black border 40 (the sheet's '60' is edge + border, the same reading as 'd' on the tabled sheets). Horizontal chain 192 / 1150 arrow / 310 / 1156 truck / 192 = 3000; vertical: arrow 412 from the top, 1140 tall, 148 to the bottom (= 1700); truck 147 / 1336 / 69 road bar / 148 = 1700 (the '20' next to the 69 is not part of the chain; the bar is drawn 69 thick, 1100 long, x 1680-2780, 30 in from the truck's extremes, as measured on the sheet). Arrow and truck are the sheet PDF's own filled vector paths (tools/symbols/qld_w1-8-q01_arrow.svg, qld_w1-8-q01_truck.svg, extracted with vec2sym, not traced): the drawn arrow is 1130 wide (440 head + 690 outer radius, agreeing with the detail: shaft 220, R470 inner, head 440 x 580, barb ends R40; the detail's '30' and '125' could not be resolved), 20 less than the dimensioned 1150, so it is centred in the 1150 box at x 192 (drawn at x 216 on the sheet); truck drawn 1158.5 x 1331.4, placed in its 1156 x 1336 box (right edge 192 from the sign edge as dimensioned). Speed numerals 400E (Series E, cap height 400) 'insert appropriate speed limit, if applicable', '40' shown dashed in a 774 x 400 box at x 196 (192 nominal), cap top 1152 = 1700 - 148 - 400, centred on the box (cx 579); the numeral mirrors with the hand (under the arrow on both hands). Speed values 20-80 in steps of 10 (note 3: multiples of 10 km/h): the curve advisory speeds used in Queensland practice, not every value (Russell 2026-09-09). Black on retroreflective yellow.
